name: Omega
source:
A demon who invaded Kamiyama City with a horde of monsters in tow.
Possessing overwhelming magical power, he is a formidable foe capable of holding his own—or even gaining the upper hand—against four Magic Knights.
He has an arrogant and haughty personality and views humans as no better than pebbles by the roadside.
